Class CargoHold

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.model.componentClasses.Component
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.model.componentClasses.ConfigurableComponent
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.model.componentClasses.CargoHold
Direct Known Subclasses:
CargoSpecial
public class CargoHold extends ConfigurableComponent
CargoHold class represents a cargo hold component in the game. It can hold goods of different colors, but not red.
